# SIGNATURE CREATIONS

**CAPTAIN’S BREAKFAST**

Cap’n Crunch® Ice Cream, Strawberries, Bananas, Nutella®, Whipped Cream

**CHOCOLATE COMBUSTION**

Chocolate Ice Cream, Brownie Bites, Mini Chocolate Chips, Chocolate Fudge Drizzle, Whipped Cream

**COOKIE MONSTER**

Cookie Monster Ice Cream, Chips Ahoy® Cookies, Oreo® Cookies, Chocolate Fudge Drizzle, Whipped Cream

**ELEMINT**

Mint Ice Cream, Oreo® Cookies, Mini Chocolate Chips, Chocolate Fudge Drizzle, Whipped Cream

**PARTY ANIMAL**

Frosted Animal Cookie Ice Cream, Frosted Animal Cookies, Mini Marshmallows, Rainbow Sprinkles, Whipped Cream

**QUANTUM COFFEE 
**

**S’MORES**

**SPECULOOS OVERLOAD**

**STRAWBERRY BOND**

Madagascar Vanilla Bean Ice Cream, Strawberries, Cheesecake Bites, Strawberry Sundae, Whipped Cream

**TROPICAL PARADISE**

Non-Dairy Pina Colada Sorbet, Strawberries, Strawberry Sundae

**UNICORN**

Birthday Cake Ice Cream, Mini Marshmallows, Unicorn Dust, Marshmallow Cream, Whipped Cream

**CARAMEL BROWNIE BATTER**

Chocolate Ice Cream, Brownie Bark, Brownie Batter, Caramel, Whipped Cream

# PREMIUM ICE CREAM CAKES

**BIRTHDAY CAKE**

Birthday Cake ice cream and vanilla cake topped with sprinkles, candy-colored white chocolate ganache, and celebratory waffle cone

**CHOCOLATE**

Rich, chocolate ice cream and chocolate cake frosted with chocolate cream and chocolate ganache mirror glaze

**COOKIES & CREAM**

Cookies & Cream ice cream and chocolate cake frosted in fresh cream drizzled with chocolate and topped with Oreo® cookies

**MOCHA**

Milk Coffee ice cream and chocolate cake with coffee-infused fresh cream, garnished with chocolate covered espresso beans

**RUBY CACAO**

Ruby Cacao ice cream and vanilla sponge cake with a swirled, fresh cream frosting, garnished with Ruby Cacao pieces

**STRAWBERRY CHEESECAKEE**

Strawberry ice cream and cheesecake covered in fresh cream, crushed graham crackers, topped with fresh strawberries

**VANILLA**

Madagascar Vanilla Bean ice cream and vanilla cake frosted in fresh cream and garnished with sugar pearls

**AVAILABLE AT 
SELECT LOCATIONS**

Interested in purchasing one of our Ice-cream cakes? Visit the location page to see a complete list of participating stores.

[**LEARN MORE >**](https://www.creamistry.com/cake/)

[Order Online](https://order.creamistry.com/)

# SPECIALTY & GRAB N7 GO ITEMS

**AFFOGATO**

Freshly brewed espresso poured over Madagascar Vanilla Bean ice cream topped with whipped cream and mini chocolate chips

**ICE CREAM SANDWICH**

Fruity Pebbles® or Brownie with choice of ice cream base and flavor

**PINTS**

Take your Creamistry® favorites to-go! Selection varies by location

**GIFT CARDS**

The perfect gift for every occasion! Available in any amount. Order yours online, today!
